rationale: Thomas, as the most senior justice in the majority, would likely assign the opinion to Barrett given her well-developed structural argument about 40 C.F.R. § 152.44(a) and her ability to hold the coalition together, though Thomas himself is a strong candidate given his textual confidence. The dissenters are likely to produce at least one written dissent, with Roberts most likely to write separately given his distinct narrowing rationale that differs meaningfully from both the majority and the minority.
